doc: Re-init hook: calls func_80056A08() to reset global state, then for every active slot index < D_80073734[0] resets its D_80085458[i] entry (f00=i, f1a=0, f18=0x40, f70=0x40, f74=0x40), re-registers its D_80073740[i] request via func_80056DB4(i), OR-accumulates the request flags into a local, and flushes each with func_8005E97C(0, tmp).
